what_it_does: Evaluates whether cloud computing platforms (Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform) can effectively run high-performance computing workloads with comparable performance and ease of use compared to traditional dedicated HPC clusters. The study benchmarks 11 different applications across three cloud providers, six different computing configurations, and up to 28,672 processor cores or 256 graphics processing units (GPUs), comparing results against established on-premises HPC systems operated by a national laboratory.
